title: Test 1
it: Cambridge B1 Preliminary के प्रारूप में अभ्यास: पढ़ना (भाग 1-6) और सुनना (भाग 1-4), अनुमानित अंकों के साथ; लिखना और बोलना नमूनों के साथ अभ्यास करें। यह कोर्स से एक क़दम आगे है, जो A2 तक जाता है।

scheme.name: Cambridge B1 Preliminary
scheme.passText: पढ़ना (32 अंक) और सुनना (25), असली परीक्षा जैसे भागों के साथ। B1 के लिए लगभग दो-तिहाई सही जवाब चाहिए: यहाँ सीमा 57 में से 38 है। असली परीक्षा में नतीजा Cambridge English Scale पर आता है (140 से = B1, 160 से = B2) और लिखना व बोलना भी गिने जाते हैं।
scheme.notOfficial: यह Cambridge B1 Preliminary के प्रारूप में अभ्यास है, आधिकारिक परीक्षा नहीं: अंक सिर्फ़ अनुमान हैं। असली परीक्षा में लिखना और बोलना भी है, जिन्हें परीक्षक जाँचते हैं।
scheme.note: असली परीक्षा की तरह, निर्देश और सवाल अंग्रेज़ी में हैं। ज़रूरत हो तो निर्देश हिंदी में देखने के लिए «अनुवाद» दबाएँ।

parts.label: Part 1
parts.inst: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.itInst: हर सवाल के लिए सही जवाब चुनिए।

items.text:
LIBRARY
Books can be returned at any time using the box outside the main door.
o: You can return books even when the library is closed.
You must give your books to the librarian.
The library is open at all times.
items.e: किताबें «at any time» बाहर वाले बक्से में लौटाई जा सकती हैं: लाइब्रेरी बंद हो तब भी।

items.text:
Ollie,
The plumber's coming between 2 and 4 to fix the shower. Could you be at home then? I'll be back at 5.
Mum
o: Mum wants Ollie to fix the shower.
Ollie needs to be at home in the afternoon.
items.e: «Could you be at home then?» 2 और 4 बजे के बीच।

items.text:
FITNESS CENTRE
From 1st June, members must book all classes online. Places can no longer be reserved by phone.
o: Classes will be cheaper online from June.
Members will not be able to phone the centre.
There will be a new way to book classes.
items.e: 1 जून से सिर्फ़ ऑनलाइन बुकिंग: बुक करने का नया तरीक़ा।

items.text:
Hi Leah,
I've found the jacket you left in my car. I can drop it off on my way to work tomorrow, unless you need it tonight?
Rita
o: Rita is offering to return Leah's jacket.
Rita wants to borrow Leah's jacket.
items.e: वह काम पर जाते हुए उसकी जैकेट लौटाने की पेशकश करता है।

items.text:
STATION CAR PARK
Pay at the machine before returning to your car. The exit barrier will not open without a paid ticket.
o: You can pay when you leave the car park.
You need to pay before you go back to your car.
The machine is next to the exit barrier.
items.e: «Pay at the machine before returning to your car».

parts.label: Part 2
parts.inst: For each question, choose the correct answer. The people below all want to do a course in their free time. Read the descriptions of eight courses and decide which course would be the most suitable for each person.
parts.itInst: नीचे दिए लोग ख़ाली समय में कोई कोर्स करना चाहते हैं। आठ कोर्सों का विवरण पढ़िए और हर व्यक्ति के लिए सबसे सही चुनिए।
parts.text:
A  Photography for beginners
Learn to use your camera in six evening classes. Every Saturday we go out together to take photos in the city.

B  Italian cooking
A Saturday morning class where you cook a three-course meal and then eat it with the group. All ingredients included.

C  Spanish for travellers
A short online course: watch the videos when you want and practise with a teacher once a week by video call.

D  Garden design
Five evenings in the town hall. Bring photos of your garden and our designer will help you plan it.

E  Guitar for all
Group lessons for complete beginners on Monday evenings. Guitars can be borrowed from the school.

F  First aid
A one-day course on a Sunday. Learn what to do in an emergency and get an official certificate.

G  Creative writing
Write short stories and poems in a friendly group. Meetings on Wednesday mornings in the café of the bookshop.

H  Yoga at lunchtime
Thirty-minute classes near the business centre, Monday to Friday at 1 p.m. Perfect for office workers.

items.q: Chloe works long hours in an office in the business centre and wants to relax during the day. She can't do anything in the evenings because she looks after her children.
items.e: दोपहर के खाने के समय दफ़्तर के पास छोटी क्लासें: H.

items.q: Tom is going to work in Mexico next year. He travels a lot for his job, so he needs a course he can do at any time, from anywhere.
items.e: ऑनलाइन कोर्स, जब चाहें: C.

items.q: Maya has just started working as a sports coach for children. She needs a certificate that shows she knows how to help someone who is hurt.
items.e: आधिकारिक प्रमाणपत्र के साथ फ़र्स्ट एड: F.

items.q: Daniel has always wanted to play music, but he has never had lessons and he doesn't have an instrument. He is free after work on weekdays.
items.e: शुरुआती लोग, शाम को, गिटार उधार मिलते हैं: E.

items.q: Rosa has bought a new camera but doesn't understand how to use it. She would like to practise with other people at the weekend.
items.e: शुरुआती लोगों के लिए कोर्स, शनिवार को बाहर घूमना: A.

parts.label: Part 3
parts.inst: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.itInst: हर सवाल के लिए सही जवाब चुनिए।
parts.text:
Life on a narrowboat
by Hannah Price

Three years ago, my partner Sam and I sold our flat in Birmingham and bought a narrowboat — a long, thin boat designed for Britain's canals. Our friends thought we were crazy, and at first I wasn't sure myself.

The boat is only two metres wide, so everything has to be small: the kitchen, the bathroom, even the bed. We had to give away most of our things, which was harder than I expected. But after a few months I realised I didn't miss any of it.

Living on the water is cheaper than renting a flat, but it isn't free. We pay for a licence every year, and the boat needs regular repairs. In winter we burn wood to keep warm, and sometimes the canal freezes, so we can't move for days.

The best thing is the freedom. Every two weeks we have to move to a new place, so we've seen parts of the country we never knew existed. I work online, so I can do my job from anywhere with an internet connection — although that isn't always easy in the countryside!

Would I recommend it? Only if you don't mind a bit of discomfort. For us, waking up to the sound of ducks instead of traffic is worth it.

items.q: How did Hannah feel when she first bought the boat?
o: She was certain it was the right decision.
She was not completely sure about it.
She was worried about what her friends said.
She was excited to leave her job.
items.e: «at first I wasn't sure myself».

items.q: What surprised Hannah about giving away her things?
o: It was easier than she thought.
Her friends wanted most of them.
It was more difficult than she expected, but she soon stopped missing them.
She had to buy smaller furniture.
items.e: «harder than I expected. But… I didn't miss any of it».

items.q: What does Hannah say about the cost of living on a boat?
o: It is more expensive than renting.
It is cheaper, but there are some costs.
Wood is the most expensive thing.
items.e: «cheaper than renting a flat, but it isn't free».

items.q: Why do they move the boat every two weeks?
o: Hannah needs a better internet connection.
items.e: «Every two weeks we have to move».

items.q: What would be the best title for the text?
o: Why I would never live on a boat again
A cheap way to see Britain's cities
items.e: जगह कम पर आज़ादी बहुत: यही पाठ का मतलब है।

parts.label: Part 4
parts.inst: Five sentences have been removed from the text below. For each question, choose the correct answer. There are three extra sentences which you do not need to use.
parts.itInst: पाठ से पाँच वाक्य हटाए गए हैं। हर ख़ाली जगह के लिए सही वाक्य चुनिए। तीन वाक्य काम नहीं आएँगे।
parts.text:
The world's oldest public zoo

London Zoo opened in 1828, but at first it was not open to everyone. (16) ____ Ordinary visitors were allowed in from 1847, and soon the zoo became one of the most popular places in the city.

Over the years, the zoo has had some famous animals. One of the best known was Jumbo, an African elephant who arrived in 1865. (17) ____ When he was sold to an American circus in 1882, thousands of people wrote letters asking the zoo to keep him.

The zoo has also been important for science. (18) ____ Today, scientists from the zoo work in many countries to protect animals in danger.

Visiting the zoo today is very different from 100 years ago. (19) ____ Instead, many of them live in large areas that are similar to their natural homes.

The zoo is open every day except Christmas Day. (20) ____ Tickets are cheaper if you book online.

A  Children loved riding on his back.
B  Only scientists and members could visit it.
C  The animals are no longer kept in small cages.
D  The first public aquarium was opened there in 1853.
E  It is the biggest zoo in the world.
F  You can easily spend a whole day there.
G  The elephants were moved to another zoo.
H  Many visitors bring their own food.

items.e: शुरू में यह सबके लिए खुला नहीं था: सिर्फ़ वैज्ञानिक और सदस्य (B)।
बच्चों को Jumbo की पीठ पर बैठना बहुत पसंद था (A); इसीलिए सबने चिट्ठियाँ लिखीं।
विज्ञान के लिए अहम: पहला सार्वजनिक एक्वेरियम (D)।
अब छोटे पिंजरे नहीं (C); «Instead…» उल्टी बात शुरू करता है।
घूमने की व्यावहारिक जानकारी: पूरा दिन बिताया जा सकता है (F)।

parts.label: Part 5
parts.inst: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.itInst: हर ख़ाली जगह के लिए सही शब्द चुनिए।
parts.text:
The first sandwich

The sandwich is (21) ____ after John Montagu, the fourth Earl of Sandwich, who lived in the eighteenth century. According to the story, he loved playing cards and did not want to (22) ____ the game to eat. So he asked for some meat between two pieces of bread, which he could hold in one hand. Other people soon started to (23) ____ for "the same as Sandwich". Of course, people had eaten bread with other food for centuries, but it was Montagu who gave it its name. Today, the sandwich is one of the most popular (24) ____ in Britain: people buy billions every year, and the (25) ____ choice is chicken. It is quick, cheap and easy to carry, which (26) ____ it perfect for a busy lunch break.

items.e: «named after» = जिसका नाम … पर रखा गया।
«leave the game» = खेल छोड़ना।
«ask for» = माँगना।
«one of the most popular meals» = सबसे पसंदीदा खानों में से एक।
«the top choice» = पहली पसंद।
«makes it perfect» = इसे परफ़ेक्ट बनाता है।

parts.label: Part 6
parts.inst: For each question, write the correct answer. Write ONE word for each gap.
parts.itInst: हर ख़ाली जगह में एक शब्द लिखिए।
parts.text:
Hi Marta,

I'm writing to tell you about my new job! I started (27) ____ Monday at a hotel in the city centre. I work at the reception, so I speak English all day, (28) ____ is great practice for me. The hotel is much bigger (29) ____ I expected, and there are guests from all over the world. My manager is very patient and has helped me a lot. I've already learned how to use the booking system, but I still get nervous (30) ____ the phone rings! Next week I'm going to work at night (31) ____ the first time. I hope I don't fall asleep! Why don't you come and visit me? I'd love to show you the city. (32) ____ me know when you're free.

Love,
Giulia

items.e: «I started on Monday» (या «last Monday»)।
«…all day, which is great practice» = जो बढ़िया अभ्यास है।
«bigger than I expected».
«when the phone rings» = जब फ़ोन बजता है।
«for the first time» = पहली बार।
«Let me know» = मुझे बताना।

parts.label: Part 1
parts.inst: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear each recording twice.
parts.itInst: हर सवाल के लिए सही जवाब चुनिए। हर रिकॉर्डिंग दो बार सुनाई जाएगी।

script: Did you take the train to the conference?
I was going to, but there was a strike, so I drove. It took four hours because of the traffic. Next time I'll fly.
items.q: How did the man travel to the conference?
items.e: हड़ताल थी, इसलिए वह कार से गया।

script: Shall we meet at the café at half past five?
I finish work at five thirty, so I'd rather say six. Actually, quarter past six is safer, because of the bus.
items.q: What time will they meet?
items.e: «quarter past six then».

script: What's the weather forecast for the weekend?
Saturday should be dry but very windy, and on Sunday it's going to rain all day.
items.q: What will the weather be like on Saturday?
items.e: «dry but very windy».

script: Have you bought a present for Kate?
I looked at some books, but she reads so fast. In the end I bought her a ticket for a concert. She loves live music.
items.q: What did the woman buy for Kate?
items.e: «I bought her a ticket for a concert».

script: You look tired. Didn't you sleep well?
Not really. The neighbours had a party until two, and then my baby woke up at five.
items.q: Why is the man tired?
o: There was noise and then his baby woke up.
items.e: पड़ोसियों की पार्टी और फिर बच्चा पाँच बजे जाग गया।

script: Is the museum far from here?
It's about twenty minutes on foot, or you can take the number 12 bus. It stops right outside, but it's only every half an hour.
items.q: What does the woman say about the bus?
o: It stops far from the museum.
items.e: «only every half an hour»: कम बार आती है।

script: Hello, I bought these shoes here last week, but they're too small.
Do you want a bigger size or your money back?
I'd like to try a bigger size, please.
items.q: What does the woman want to do?
o: change the shoes for a bigger size
items.e: «I'd like to try a bigger size».

parts.label: Part 2
parts.inst: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear each conversation twice.
parts.itInst: हर सवाल के लिए सही जवाब चुनिए। हर बातचीत दो बार सुनाई जाएगी।

script: How was the new Italian restaurant?
The service was slow, and it was quite noisy, but honestly, I've never had such good pasta outside Italy.
items.q: You will hear two friends talking about a restaurant. What did the woman think of it?
items.e: सर्विस धीमी और शोर, पर इटली के बाहर खाया सबसे अच्छा पास्ता।

script: Are you enjoying your new job?
The people are great, and I'm learning a lot. I just wish it was closer to home: I spend almost two hours a day on the train.
items.q: You will hear a man talking about his new job. What doesn't he like about it?
items.e: रोज़ दो घंटे ट्रेन में: आने-जाने का सफ़र।

script: Did you finish the book I lent you?
I did. The beginning was a bit slow, to be honest, but the last chapters were so exciting that I read them in one night.
items.q: You will hear two friends talking about a book. What does the woman say about it?
o: It was boring from start to finish.
It got better towards the end.
items.e: धीमी शुरुआत, रोमांचक अंत।

script: Shall we go to the beach on Saturday?
I'd love to, but my sister is moving house, and I promised to help her.
items.q: You will hear two friends making plans. Why can't the man go to the beach?
o: He's going to help his sister.
items.e: उसने बहन को घर बदलने में मदद का वादा किया है।

script: What did you think of the film?
The actors were good, but I expected more from the story. I guessed the ending after twenty minutes.
items.q: You will hear a woman talking about a film. What did she think of it?
items.e: उसे कहानी से ज़्यादा उम्मीद थी: बीस मिनट में ही अंत समझ गई।

script: Yes, three times a week. I'm not very fast, but I sleep much better now, and that's the main thing for me.
items.q: You will hear a man talking about running. What is the most important thing for him?
items.e: «I sleep much better now, and that's the main thing».

parts.label: Part 3
parts.inst: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one or two words or a number or a date or a time. You will hear a man talking about a festival.
parts.itInst: सही जवाब लिखिए: एक या दो शब्द, संख्या, तारीख़ या समय। एक आदमी एक त्योहार के बारे में बताता है।

script: Good morning, and thanks for listening to Radio Bridgeport. This summer the town's food festival is taking place in Victoria Park, by the river.
items.q: Place: Victoria ____
items.e: «in Victoria Park».

script: It runs for three days, from Friday the nineteenth to Sunday the twenty-first of August.
items.q: Last day: Sunday ____ August
items.e: «to Sunday the twenty-first of August».

script: There'll be more than sixty stalls, with food from all over the world.
items.q: Number of stalls: more than ____
items.e: «more than sixty stalls».

script: On Saturday afternoon, there's a cooking competition for children, so if your kids like baking, bring their aprons!
items.q: Saturday afternoon: a cooking competition for ____
items.e: «a cooking competition for children».

script: Entry costs five pounds for adults, and it's free for under-twelves.
items.q: Adult ticket: £ ____
items.e: «five pounds for adults».

script: Parking near the park is limited, so we recommend coming by bike, or taking the special festival bus from the station.
items.q: Best way to get there: by bike or by ____ from the station
items.e: «the special festival bus from the station».

parts.label: Part 4
parts.inst: For each question, choose the correct answer. You will hear an interview with a young chef called Amy Ross.
parts.itInst: हर सवाल के लिए सही जवाब चुनिए। एक युवा शेफ़, Amy Ross, का इंटरव्यू सुनिए।

script: Amy, when did you start cooking?
My parents both worked late, so when I was about twelve I started making dinner for my little brothers. At first it was just pasta, but I soon began to enjoy it.
items.q: Why did Amy start cooking?
o: She did a course at school.
Her parents were often at work in the evening.
items.e: माता-पिता देर तक काम करते थे।

script: Did you study cooking after school?
I wanted to, but my parents thought I should go to university first. So I studied history, and I worked in restaurants at weekends.
items.q: What did Amy do after school?
o: She worked full-time in a restaurant.
items.e: उसने यूनिवर्सिटी में इतिहास पढ़ा।

script: What was your first job as a chef like?
Very hard! The hours were long and the head chef shouted a lot. But I learned how a real kitchen works, and I'm grateful for that.
items.q: How does Amy feel about her first job now?
o: She's glad she learned so much.
She wishes she had never done it.
items.e: «I learned how a real kitchen works, and I'm grateful».

script: Your restaurant only uses local food. Why is that?
Partly because it tastes better, but mainly because I want to help the farmers in this area. Many of them are struggling.
items.q: What is the main reason Amy uses local food?
o: She wants to support local farmers.
items.e: «mainly because I want to help the farmers».

script: What advice would you give young people who want to become chefs?
Don't worry about being famous. Cook as often as you can, and say yes to every chance to learn, even if it's washing dishes.
items.q: What advice does Amy give?
o: Never accept a job washing dishes.
items.e: «say yes to every chance to learn».

script: People keep asking me to write a cookbook, but for now I'm planning to open a cooking school for teenagers next spring.
items.q: What is Amy planning to do next?
items.e: «I'm planning to open a cooking school for teenagers».

practice.task: Read this email from your English friend Alex and write your answer in about 100 words. "Hi! I'm coming to your town for a week in July. What's the best way to travel from the airport? What should I visit? And would you like to do something together one evening? Alex"
practice.tr: अपने अंग्रेज़ दोस्त Alex के ईमेल का जवाब दीजिए (लगभग 100 शब्द): एयरपोर्ट से कैसे आएँ, क्या देखें, एक शाम साथ में क्या करें।
practice.model: Hi Alex, great news! The easiest way to get from the airport is the shuttle bus: it leaves every twenty minutes and takes you to the central station in half an hour. You should definitely visit the old town and climb the tower, because the view is amazing. If you like art, the city museum is free on Sundays. Of course I'd love to meet! On Friday evenings there's a street food market by the river, so we could go there and then have a drink in the square. Let me know which day you arrive. See you soon, Luca

practice.task: Write a story of about 100 words. Your story must begin with this sentence: "When I opened the door, I couldn't believe my eyes."
practice.tr: लगभग 100 शब्दों की एक कहानी लिखिए जो ऐसे शुरू हो: «जब मैंने दरवाज़ा खोला, मुझे अपनी आँखों पर यक़ीन नहीं हुआ।»
practice.model: When I opened the door, I couldn't believe my eyes. All my friends were standing in my living room, and there were balloons everywhere. It was my thirtieth birthday, but I thought everybody had forgotten. That morning nobody had called me, and at work my colleagues hadn't said anything. My sister had organised everything: she had invited twenty people and made a huge chocolate cake. We danced and laughed until two in the morning. It was the best surprise of my life, and the next day I called my sister to thank her again.

practice.task: Part 1: answer questions about yourself (where you live, your studies or job, your free time). Part 2: describe a photo for about one minute (for example, a family having a picnic in a park).
practice.tr: भाग 1: अपने बारे में सवालों के जवाब दीजिए। भाग 2: एक तस्वीर का लगभग एक मिनट वर्णन कीजिए (जैसे पार्क में पिकनिक करता एक परिवार)।
practice.model: In this photo I can see a family having a picnic in a park. There are two parents and two children, a boy and a girl. They're sitting on a blanket under a big tree. It looks like a sunny day in summer, because they're wearing T-shirts and shorts. The mother is giving the children some sandwiches and the father is pouring a drink. In the background there are some other people walking a dog. I think they're having a good time, because they're all smiling.

practice.task: Part 3: with a partner, discuss a situation (for example, which activities a group of students could do at a new youth centre) and decide together. Part 4: talk about related questions (Do you prefer doing activities alone or with friends? Why?).
practice.tr: भाग 3: एक साथी के साथ किसी स्थिति पर चर्चा कीजिए (जैसे नए युवा केंद्र में कौन-सी गतिविधियाँ हों) और साथ में फ़ैसला कीजिए। भाग 4: जुड़े हुए सवालों के जवाब दीजिए।
practice.model: I think a music room would be a great idea, because a lot of teenagers want to learn an instrument but they can't practise at home. What do you think? … Yes, I agree that a sports hall is important too, but it's expensive. Maybe we could choose the music room and a games room, because they're cheaper and many people can use them. … Personally, I prefer doing activities with friends, because it's more fun and you can help each other.
